title: Object Detectors Emerge in Deep Scene CNNs

problem.summary: One important factor for continued progress is to understand the representations that are learned by the inner layers of these deep architectures.
statements: One important factor for continued progress is to understand the representations that are learned by the inner layers of these deep architectures.
Here we show that object detectors emerge from training CNNs to perform scene classification.
As scenes are composed of objects, the CNN for scene classification automatically discovers meaningful objects detectors, representative of the learned scene categories.
